lines: Two students. Same chapter. Same three hours.
Sam reads it three times. It feels easy. It feels familiar.
Dev reads it once, closes the book, and writes down everything he remembers.
It feels awful. He gets half of it wrong.
Sam feels ready. Dev feels behind.
Pulling it back out is what makes it stay.
Familiar isn't the same as remembered.
Are you a Sam, or a Dev?
